purpose: Adapt the publishing platform (itch, Yandex Games, plain desktop) behind one Autoload so the rest of the game never touches a platform SDK.
state_owner: Detected platform id and the active platform adapter
State of the pending advertisement request

platform_v1.id: Platform.id is "yandex", "itch" or "desktop", taken from the export preset custom feature tag.
platform_v1.show_ad: Platform.show_ad() -> void asks for a fullscreen advertisement; ad_finished(shown: bool) fires once, immediately with false when the platform has no ads.
platform_v1.adapter: platform_adapter.gd is the base class; yandex_adapter.gd calls the Yandex Games SDK through JavaScriptBridge, mock_platform_adapter.gd drives tests without an SDK.
